# Kirk's Mountain Adventures

> > Premier guided outdoor adventure company specializing in llama trekking, hiking, and backcountry experiences in Rocky Mountain National Park and Estes Park, Colorado.

Kirk's Mountain Adventures (KMA) is a family-run outfitter offering guided and self-guided adventures year-round, from 14er summit attempts on Longs Peak to unique llama-assisted camping trips. Based in Estes Park, they provide expert-led tours throughout Rocky Mountain National Park with options for all skill levels.

## Key Topics

- Estes Park
- Rocky Mountain National Park (RMNP)
- Llama trekking and hiking
- Guided hiking tours
- Longs Peak 14er climbs
- Backcountry camping
- Snowshoeing adventures
- Colorado hiking
- Family-friendly outdoor activities
- Backpacking trips
- Self-guided llama camping
- Year-round guided tours
- Big Thompson River
- Outdoor gear rental

## Guided Adventures & Tours

- [Guided Day Hikes](https://www.kirksmountainadventures.com/guided-day-hikes): Guided day hikes and llama hiking tours in Rocky Mountain National Park
- [Guided Longs Peak Trips](https://www.kirksmountainadventures.com/guided-longs-peak-trips): Guided summit trips for Longs Peak 14er in Rocky Mountain National Park
- [Guided Backpacking Trips](https://www.kirksmountainadventures.com/backpacking-trips): Overnight guided backpacking trips in Rocky Mountain National Park
- [Guided Snowshoeing & Backcountry Adventures](https://www.kirksmountainadventures.com/group-backcountry-adventure): Winter snowshoeing & multi-day backcountry camping adventures in RMNP

## Llama Adventures

- [Llama Day Hikes](https://www.kirksmountainadventures.com/llama-hike): Family-friendly llama day hikes in Rocky Mountain National Park
- [Overnight Llama Pack Trips](https://www.kirksmountainadventures.com/camp-with-a-llama): Overnight llama pack trips in Rocky Mountain National Park backcountry
- [Self-Guided Llama Camping](https://www.kirksmountainadventures.com/self-guided-llama-camping): Self-guided llama camping on Big Thompson River with gear included
